causal_judgment.mechanism: FreeLibrary invokes CRT/static teardown under Windows loader synchronization. The image-local reaper destructor waits for its worker. Worker exit can require DLL_THREAD_DETACH/loader synchronization, yielding a known deadlock condition. Source and linkmap establish this reachable pattern, not conclusive attribution of the current hang.
not_established: No complete main-thread stack proving CRT detach -> reaper destructor -> Thread::join
No worker stack proving a loader-lock wait
Vendor global teardown has not been excluded
No new G09 product correctness or performance defect follows from this timeout
causal_judgment.same_before_after: Relevant backend source is exactly identical in baseline and candidate. No product reopening is authorized.

parent_supplied_observations_not_indepen.original_terminal: Parent checked executable identity, stopped the hung process, and retained DIAGNOSTIC_FAIL and elapsed cost. This review does not rewrite the result.

finite_recommendation.platform: Windows only; no Apple/Mach-O dlclose qualification inferred.
finite_recommendation.ownership: Keep both facade images mapped for process lifetime. Preserve explicit user State destruction and original warm output/lease release plus Scheduler::drain. Do not retain user invocations/results to bypass retirement.
finite_recommendation.fairness: Apply the same image lifetime to both arms and both load/allocation orders. Record image-local worker/vendor cache memory as process-retained or UNKNOWN, not zero cost. Charged warm retirement remains unchanged.
finite_recommendation.process_exit: Normal process exit remains an actual diagnostic requirement. Retaining images removes the explicit-unload edge but does not guarantee all vendor or process-detach code is safe. Do not mask a hang/nonzero exit with an exit shortcut.
finite_recommendation.verdict_limit: Public computation and explicit user-state retirement may be assessed separately while dynamic unload remains unqualified. This is a benchmark lifetime choice, not a shipping SDK change or plugin-unload feature.
